reason: Forwarding custom testers to asymmetric matchers is the intended contract (Jest does the same), and the actual fix deliberately removes only subset-equality testers while explicitly keeping user/iterable/strict testers flowing to matchers ("Testers that are not subset testers still reach matchers ... behave as before"), so the claim's generalized concern about unfiltered user-registered testers — plus its premise that the list "was previously sanitized" — misreads the code and the defect.
